'''Fianna Urshant''' was the daughter of [[Andus Urshant]] and [[Zoam Urshant]]. She was six years old when her family evacuated [[Demophon]] before its [[Demophon (star)|sun]] went [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]]. During this time she wanted to be a [[Prince/Legends|princess]] when she grew up.<ref name="TC" />
